featureRecomputation.method: independent raw-match replay before each forecast, two-hour result delay

home.meaning: At zero prior matches the exported means use the same declared 1.3-goal/xG prior, while xG coverage is zero; these priors are not observed xG.

away.meaning: At zero prior matches the exported means use the same declared 1.3-goal/xG prior, while xG coverage is zero; these priors are not observed xG.

featureProfile.structuralRedundancyInterpretation: Algebraic dependence is descriptive and does not establish that dropping a feature improves tree-model generalization.

descriptiveSeasonDrift.interpretation: Unadjusted descriptive changes only: league composition, partial seasons and sampling uncertainty can explain differences; no causal structural break is established.

teamIdentity.limitation: Source export contains team IDs but no names or identity-transition evidence; physical identity/alias correctness cannot be proven from this export alone.

limitations: Availability is reconstructed as kickoff plus two hours; no contemporaneous source-version history is present.
No bookmaker odds are used as ML feature columns in this dataset.
Raw trainer ECE averages all three class probabilities; pipeline ECE measures maximum-confidence accuracy. They are not directly comparable.

Pipeline report does not persist all post-calibration predictions; weighted fold log loss/Brier are independently checked, while exact pipeline transforms require the saved calibration profiles and existing TypeScript implementation.

developmentProtocol.featureReductionRule: For each check fold use only current or preceding selection windows: positive group permutation in min(2, available folds) windows and positive mean; basic always retained
developmentProtocol.futureAcceptance: A new prospective period after experiment registration is required; the old 745 are permanently retired from tuning.
developmentProtocol.individualFeatureReductionRule: Per check fold retain A lambdas and league indicators; any other feature requires selection-only permutation weekly CI lower>0 in min(2, available previous/current selection folds). No future selection is consulted.

limitations: Training scores are in-sample, never evidence of future quality.
Only the final development fold's fitted model is used for seasonal comparisons; sample composition can explain attribution shifts.
Development check periods are already observable and can support diagnosis, never a new independent success claim.
No odds are ML features; there are no quote-labelled economic results in this file.
Feature importance, SHAP and permutation do not imply causality; correlated predictors can divide attribution.
History ablation limits training labels, not the historical depth already encoded in frozen feature averages.
The legacy isotonic comparison is normalized onto the 1X2 simplex before scoring; the old incoherent runtime vector is not deployed.
